summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Employee Portal features. All 8 features verified working - backend APIs (17/17 tests passed) and frontend UI (all flows functional).
passed_tests: ✅ Employee Portal Login page loads correctly at /employee-portal/login
✅ Invalid login shows error message 'Invalid email or PIN'
✅ Dashboard shows clock status, hours worked, break time at /employee-portal
✅ Clock In button works - status changes to 'Clocked In' with green badge
✅ Break button works - status changes to 'On Break' with amber badge
✅ End Break button works - returns to 'Clocked In' status
✅ Clock Out button works - status changes to 'Clocked Out'
✅ Toast notifications show for all clock actions
✅ My Pay page shows current period earnings, YTD, balance owed at /employee-portal/pay
✅ My Tasks page shows assigned tasks (or 'All caught up' if none) at /employee-portal/tasks
✅ Profile page shows employee info (name, email, phone, hourly rate) and clock history at /employee-portal/profile
✅ Bottom navigation between Clock, My Pay, Tasks, Profile works
✅ Sign Out functionality works - redirects to login page
✅ Auth header Authorization: Bearer token properly passed to all API endpoints
seed_data_creation: None - used existing employee data (John Worker)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Employee Portal is fully functional. Test employee: john@signshop.com / PIN 5678. All features working: login, dashboard, clock in/out, break start/end, pay summary, tasks, profile, clock history, bottom navigation, sign out.
